convention: Non-blocking issues discovered during this read-only audit are logged as open BACKLOG rows per GOV-014 (plans/GOVERNANCE.md); nothing here has been fixed or committed.

rows.gap_summary: Source-build installation branch never emits dependency classification (required/optional/dev/native), so dependency truth is silently absent rather than explicitly verified-zero.
rows.repair: Add a dependency-classification slot to the source_build installation template, sourced from existing manifest facts.

rows.gap_summary: Method Index includes any member merely because its name is textually mentioned elsewhere in the document, pulling in NotImplementedError stubs (Mesh.union/do_boolean/etc., NurbsCurve.evaluate, NurbsSurface.to_mesh) and presenting them as normal working API, contradicting the Scope and Limitations section.
rows.repair: Exclude or annotate members already classified as raising NotImplementedError before including them in the Method Index.

rows.gap_summary: The public API surface is rendered three overlapping times in one candidate (namespace table, orphan bullet list, Method Index) with no deduplication.
rows.repair: Deduplicate API-surface renderers so only one representation is emitted per candidate.

rows.gap_summary: Case-sensitive `compiled_blocks.get(heading)` lookup fails for any unit whose extracted heading_text casing (e.g. 'At a glance') differs from the template compiler's canonical casing (e.g. 'At a Glance'), leaving `target` blank for 21 of 24 units even when the content genuinely exists in the candidate.
rows.repair: Normalize case (or use a slug/casefold comparison) when matching heading_text against compiled_slot_blocks keys.

rows.gap_summary: The computed disposition-ledger validity (`ledger_valid`) is never consulted by the promotion/status decision, so a candidate with 21 real ledger errors can still be reported DELIVERED with 'none' open issues at the portfolio level.
rows.repair: Make the promotion status conditional on ledger_valid, and make RESULTS.md supersede stale per-repo rows instead of only appending.

rows.gap_summary: When no catalogued class member matches _EXAMPLE_ENTRY_MEMBERS, the function falls back to a bare, content-free constructor call (e.g. `scene = Scene()`), which then ships as the entire Quick Start section.
rows.repair: Extend the entry-point matching to recognize Scene.open()/Scene.save() (or similar) as valid one-call entry points before falling back to a bare constructor-only example.

rows.gap_summary: No check compares a Scope-and-Limitations 'not implemented' bullet against method calls demonstrated as working in the same candidate's code examples, allowing a direct in-document contradiction to ship.
rows.repair: Add a cross-check between limitation claims and example call sites before a candidate can be accepted.

rows.gap_summary: Opening-line binder produced a single-symbology (Code 128-only) product description when the product supports seven symbologies.
rows.repair: Bind the opening sentence to the full product.capabilities fact set, not a single narrowed identity fact.

rows.gap_summary: Emits stale/false per-symbology limitation strings from bootstrap.py verbatim ('Only the SVG backend is implemented for Code 128/Code 39') without validating them against the shared renderer implementation or demonstrated examples.
rows.repair: Cross-validate each limitation phrase against source/example evidence before emission; fix the stale source strings in bootstrap.py.

rows.gap_summary: Ledger is always built against whatever README is currently checked out at the target repo's HEAD, never against a designated true pre-refresh original, and independently produces fabricated DROPPED rows for units (H1, Key Capabilities, API Reference) that are actually present in the candidate.
rows.repair: Support reconciling against an explicitly designated old-README baseline distinct from the live checkout, and fix the DROPPED-classification logic to check actual presence in render['final_text'] before recording a drop.

rows.gap_summary: Computes disposition_ledger_valid/errors but nothing in the acceptance pipeline gates promotion on this result; a candidate with 3 unresolved ledger errors was still promoted.
rows.repair: Fail closed on disposition_ledger_valid=false before writing README.md/marking the run accepted.

rows.gap_summary: QR Code, a real major capability, is absent from both the At-a-Glance diagram and Key Capabilities list.
rows.repair: Ensure every top-level product.capabilities entry is represented in the overview diagram/list, or explicitly logs any capability it excludes.

rows.gap_summary: Falls back to fixed generic boilerplate sentences ('Build the corresponding content through the public object model.') when related_types resolves empty, producing repetitive, low-information capability bullets.
rows.repair: Derive a source-grounded descriptive sentence (e.g., from docstrings) instead of a fixed template string when related_types is empty.

rows.gap_summary: Every API Method Index row uses the identical templated sentence pattern 'Calls the `<op>` operation on `<Class>`.', reading as machine filler.
rows.repair: Prefer a signature/docstring-derived description per method, falling back to the template only when no richer source text exists.

rows.gap_summary: The Quick Start section is bound to a trivial 'instantiate a renderer' snippet instead of a complete generate+render workflow.
rows.repair: Re-derive the development.golden_workflow fact for this repository to capture a full working example, and add a check that a Quick Start slot must include at least one generation and one render call before acceptance.

rows.gap_summary: A false aspose_checks value carries no visible finding detail into validation.json and cannot be independently investigated from persisted evidence.
rows.repair: Persist the actual list of aspose_check_findings (not just the aggregate boolean) alongside deterministic_checks.

rows.gap_summary: 2 blocking claim-accountability conflicts left unresolved for this candidate while delivery proceeded.
rows.repair: Block delivery when claim_accountability_complete is false; surface the specific claim IDs for resolution.

rows.gap_summary: 16 heading units marked VERIFIED_MERGED/SUPERSEDED with an empty target field, making the preservation ledger invalid by its own check.
rows.repair: Populate the target field with the real candidate destination for every retained/superseded unit; fail the run (not just log) on any _disposition_acceptance error.

rows.function: build_source_disposition_ledger (line 96) -- has no code-block-level disposition class
rows.gap_summary: The 'Extract Attached Files' code example from the predecessor README has no equivalent anywhere in the delivered candidate and no disclosed reason.
rows.repair: Rewrite the Extract Attached Files example using open()/write() as was done for the sibling image-save example, and add a dedicated code-block-level disposition ledger.

rows.function: badge selection/target logic (no ledger equivalent exists)
rows.gap_summary: The predecessor README's CI badge is dropped with zero accounting; a Contributors badge and banner image are added with zero accounting.
rows.repair: Add a badge/media disposition ledger (mirroring Aspose's own badge-dispositions.json) to the POC delivery path.

rows.gap_summary: README.md is written and the run recorded as deliverable regardless of deterministic_verdict; RESULTS.md's hand-curated top summary table ('DELIVERED'/'none') is not reconciled against the auto-appended diagnostic log showing DIAGNOSTIC_VALIDATION_reject for the same candidate.
rows.repair: Gate README/evidence writing on deterministic_verdict=='accept', or clearly propagate reject status into whatever process produces the top RESULTS.md summary table; regenerate that table from the same status data as the auto-appended log.

rows.gap_summary: independent_review_verdict recorded ACCEPT despite an unresolved blocking claim conflict found by the deterministic layer moments earlier in the same run.
rows.repair: Pass the deterministic claim-accountability findings into the review gate so ACCEPT cannot be recorded while blocking claims remain unresolved.

rows.gap_summary: Recomposing the candidate for the no-op/reproducibility proof required 2 new LLM provider calls, so the rerun is not a true deterministic replay despite the bytes matching.
rows.repair: Investigate and remove the non-determinism in the recomposition/caching path so a sealed rerun needs zero new provider calls.
